headline: Himadri Speciality Chemical Limited: Demerger
sum: Demerger - Himadri Speciality Chemical Limited has informed the Exchange about Scheme of Arrangement between Dalmia Bharat Refractories Limited ( Demerged Company ) and Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd ( Resulting Company ) and their…
detail: Demerger - Himadri Speciality Chemical Limited has informed the Exchange about Scheme of Arrangement between Dalmia Bharat Refractories Limited ( Demerged Company ) and Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd ( Resulting Company ) and their respective shareholders and creditors under Section 230-232 and other applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013
